integrity: Statements follow explicit rank-one algebra and exact symbolic graph checks; no claim of independent verification or publication priority.
scientific_limitations: One hostile link added to a connected positive undirected graph with unit anchoring and nonzero nonnegative innate opinion. Polarization is mean squared opinion about zero. The size bound is sharp but not a four-node census; no multiedge or general signed-base statement is made. Independent literature overlap remains possible.
title: Single-hostile-link polarization has a sharp reentrant regime and a four-vertex unweighted boundary
